verdict.rationale: Community reports show uv resolving and publishing packages against an internal GitLab package registry (uv-comm-6, uv-comm-9). The docs also mention that dependencies can come from "alternative sources" (uv-docs-70), so pointing uv at a private registry is at least implied. Nothing in the pack documents how to configure an index or mirror, or how authentication is provided or scoped. Missing for 10: first-party docs on configuring private indexes/mirrors, documented credential handling and per-index scoped authentication, mirror/proxy configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of authenticated private-registry use.
